package reconcile

import (
	"fmt"
	"math/rand"
	"os"
	"slices"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type zfile struct {
	md5    string
	size   int64
	mtime  int64
	origin string // scan path it came from, or "dl:<id>"
}

func zgen(r *rand.Rand) Input {
	if os.Getenv("ZZ_DIR") == "2" {
		return zgen2(r)
	}
	if os.Getenv("ZZ_DIR") != "" {
		return zgenDir(r)
	}
	names := []string{"a.txt", "b.txt", "c.txt", "d.txt", "e.txt"}
	in := Input{Base: map[string]BaseItem{}, Local: map[string]LocalItem{}, Remote: map[string]RemoteItem{}}
	nb := 2 + r.Intn(3)
	perm := r.Perm(len(names))
	for i := 0; i < nb; i++ {
		p := names[perm[i]]
		id := "I" + strconv.Itoa(i)
		in.Base[p] = BaseItem{FileID: id, Size: int64(10 + i), MD5: "B" + strconv.Itoa(i), MtimeNS: 1000, DriveMD5: "B" + strconv.Itoa(i), DriveVersion: 1}
	}
	// Drive
	used := map[string]bool{}
	type pend struct {
		p string
		b BaseItem
	}
	var ps []pend
	for _, p := range zsorted(mapsKeys(in.Base)) {
		ps = append(ps, pend{p, in.Base[p]})
	}
	r.Shuffle(len(ps), func(i, j int) { ps[i], ps[j] = ps[j], ps[i] })
	for _, x := range ps {
		if r.Intn(100) < 12 {
			continue
		}
		dst := x.p
		if r.Intn(100) < 55 {
			dst = names[r.Intn(len(names))]
		}
		if used[dst] {
			dst = x.p
			if used[dst] {
				continue
			}
		}
		used[dst] = true
		md5, size := x.b.MD5, x.b.Size
		if r.Intn(100) < 25 {
			md5, size = "D"+x.b.FileID, x.b.Size+100
		}
		in.Remote[dst] = RemoteItem{FileID: x.b.FileID, MD5: md5, Size: size, Version: 2}
	}
	for k, n := range names {
		if !used[n] && r.Intn(100) < 15 {
			in.Remote[n] = RemoteItem{FileID: "R" + strconv.Itoa(k), MD5: "RN" + strconv.Itoa(k), Size: int64(200 + k), Version: 1}
			used[n] = true
		}
	}
	// Local
	lused := map[string]bool{}
	mt := int64(2000)
	for _, p := range zsorted(mapsKeys(in.Base)) {
		b := in.Base[p]
		x := r.Intn(100)
		switch {
		case x < 12:
			continue
		case x < 40:
			mt++
			in.Local[p] = LocalItem{MD5: "L" + b.FileID, Size: b.Size + 50, MtimeNS: mt}
		default:
			in.Local[p] = LocalItem{MD5: b.MD5, Size: b.Size, MtimeNS: 1000}
		}
		lused[p] = true
	}
	// user renames
	for _, p := range zsorted(mapsKeys(in.Local)) {
		if r.Intn(100) < 10 {
			n := names[r.Intn(len(names))]
			if !lused[n] {
				in.Local[n] = in.Local[p]
				delete(in.Local, p)
				lused[n], lused[p] = true, false
			}
		}
	}
	for k, n := range names {
		if lused[n] || r.Intn(100) > 25 {
			continue
		}
		mt++
		var md5 string
		var size int64
		switch r.Intn(3) {
		case 0:
			md5, size = "N"+strconv.Itoa(k), int64(300+k)
		case 1:
			var rs []RemoteItem
			for _, q := range zsorted(mapsKeys(in.Remote)) {
				rs = append(rs, in.Remote[q])
			}
			if len(rs) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			x := rs[r.Intn(len(rs))]
			md5, size = x.MD5, x.Size
		default:
			var bs []BaseItem
			for _, q := range zsorted(mapsKeys(in.Base)) {
				bs = append(bs, in.Base[q])
			}
			x := bs[r.Intn(len(bs))]
			md5, size = x.MD5, x.Size
		}
		in.Local[n] = LocalItem{MD5: md5, Size: size, MtimeNS: mt}
		lused[n] = true
	}
	return in
}

func zsorted(s []string) []string { slices.Sort(s); return s }

func mapsKeys[V any](m map[string]V) []string {
	var out []string
	for k := range m {
		out = append(out, k)
	}
	return out
}

// zsim runs plan on a model; fail: set of action indexes that fail before effect;
// commitFail: indexes of moves that fail after rename; crashAfter: stop after index (-1 none).
func zsim(in Input, plan []Action, fail map[int]bool, commitFail map[int]bool, crashAt int) (loc map[string]zfile, uploaded map[string]bool, bad []string) {
	loc = map[string]zfile{}
	for p, l := range in.Local {
		if !l.IsDir {
			loc[p] = zfile{l.MD5, l.Size, l.MtimeNS, p}
		}
	}
	uploaded = map[string]bool{}
	bin := map[string]bool{}
	failed := map[string]bool{}
	protector := func(t Type) bool {
		return t == ConflictBackup || t == MoveLocal || t == MoveRemote || t == Forget
	}
	baseByID := map[string]string{}
	for p, b := range in.Base {
		baseByID[b.FileID] = p
	}
	remByID := map[string]string{}
	for p, r := range in.Remote {
		remByID[r.FileID] = p
	}
	dlN := int64(900000)
	for i, a := range plan {
		if crashAt >= 0 && i > crashAt {
			break
		}
		doFail := func() {
			if protector(a.Type) {
				failed[a.RelPath] = true
			}
		}
		if a.ProtectedBy != "" && failed[a.ProtectedBy] {
			doFail()
			continue
		}
		if fail[i] {
			doFail()
			continue
		}
		guard := func(p string, pinned bool, size, mt int64) bool {
			f, ok := loc[p]
			if !ok {
				return true
			}
			if !pinned {
				return false
			}
			return f.size == size && f.mtime == mt
		}
		switch a.Type {
		case MoveLocal:
			if a.IsDir {
				pre := a.RelPath + "/"
				for _, k := range zsorted(mapsKeys(loc)) {
					if strings.HasPrefix(k, pre) {
						loc[a.NewRelPath+"/"+k[len(pre):]] = loc[k]
						delete(loc, k)
					}
				}
				if commitFail[i] {
					doFail()
				}
				continue
			}
			f, ok := loc[a.RelPath]
			if !ok {
				doFail()
				continue
			}
			if a.RelPath != a.NewRelPath && !guard(a.NewRelPath, a.LocalExists, a.LocalSize, a.LocalMtimeNS) {
				doFail()
				continue
			}
			delete(loc, a.RelPath)
			loc[a.NewRelPath] = f
			if commitFail[i] {
				doFail()
			}
		case ConflictBackup:
			f, ok := loc[a.RelPath]
			if !ok || !guard(a.NewRelPath, false, 0, 0) {
				doFail()
				continue
			}
			delete(loc, a.RelPath)
			loc[a.NewRelPath] = f
		case QuarantineLocal:
			f, ok := loc[a.RelPath]
			if ok {
				if a.LocalExists && (f.size != a.LocalSize || f.mtime != a.LocalMtimeNS) {
					doFail()
					continue
				}
				bin[f.md5] = true
				delete(loc, a.RelPath)
			}
		case Download:
			if !guard(a.RelPath, a.LocalExists, a.LocalSize, a.LocalMtimeNS) {
				doFail()
				continue
			}
			dlN++
			loc[a.RelPath] = zfile{a.MD5, a.Size, dlN, "dl:" + a.FileID}
		case Upload, UpdateRemote:
			f, ok := loc[a.RelPath]
			if !ok {
				doFail()
				continue
			}
			uploaded[f.md5] = true
			if a.Type == UpdateRemote && !strings.HasPrefix(f.origin, "dl:") {
				// mis-bind heuristic: origin should be the row's base path or Drive path
				bp := baseByID[a.FileID]
				if f.origin != bp && f.origin != remByID[a.FileID] && !(strings.HasPrefix(bp, "D/") && f.origin == "N"+bp[1:]) {
					bad = append(bad, fmt.Sprintf("update_remote %s (id %s) uploads file from %s", a.RelPath, a.FileID, f.origin))
				}
			}
		case Record:
			if !a.IsDir {
				f, ok := loc[a.RelPath]
				if !ok || f.size != a.LocalSize || f.mtime != a.LocalMtimeNS {
					doFail()
					continue
				}
				if f.md5 != a.MD5 {
					bad = append(bad, fmt.Sprintf("record %s md5 %s but file holds %s", a.RelPath, a.MD5, f.md5))
				}
			}
		}
	}
	for m := range bin {
		uploaded[m] = true // kept in the bin
	}
	return loc, uploaded, bad
}

func zkept(in Input) map[string]bool {
	k := map[string]bool{}
	for _, b := range in.Base {
		if b.MD5 == b.DriveMD5 {
			k[b.MD5] = true
		}
	}
	for _, r := range in.Remote {
		k[r.MD5] = true
	}
	return k
}

func zdump(in Input, plan []Action) string {
	var sb strings.Builder
	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Base:")
	for _, p := range zsorted(mapsKeys(in.Base)) {
		b := in.Base[p]
		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, " %s(%s,%s)", p, b.FileID, b.MD5)
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "\nLocal:")
	for _, p := range zsorted(mapsKeys(in.Local)) {
		l := in.Local[p]
		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, " %s(%s,%d,%d)", p, l.MD5, l.Size, l.MtimeNS)
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "\nRemote:")
	for _, p := range zsorted(mapsKeys(in.Remote)) {
		r := in.Remote[p]
		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, " %s(%s,%s)", p, r.FileID, r.MD5)
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "\nPlan:\n")
	for i, a := range plan {
		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "  %d %s %s", i, a.Type, a.RelPath)
		if a.NewRelPath != "" {
			fmt.Fprintf(&sb, " -> %s", a.NewRelPath)
		}
		if a.FileID != "" {
			fmt.Fprintf(&sb, " id=%s", a.FileID)
		}
		if a.ProtectedBy != "" {
			fmt.Fprintf(&sb, " PB=%s", a.ProtectedBy)
		}
		if a.LocalExists {
			fmt.Fprintf(&sb, " pin=%d/%d", a.LocalSize, a.LocalMtimeNS)
		}
		sb.WriteString("\n")
	}
	return sb.String()
}

func TestZZReview(t *testing.T) {
	n := 200000
	if s := os.Getenv("ZZ_N"); s != "" {
		n, _ = strconv.Atoi(s)
	}
	reported := map[string]int{}
	var outf *os.File
	if o := os.Getenv("ZZ_OUT"); o != "" {
		outf, _ = os.Create(o)
		defer outf.Close()
	}
	status := func(seed int, s string) {
		if outf != nil {
			fmt.Fprintf(outf, "%d %s\n", seed, s)
		}
	}
	for seed := 0; seed < n; seed++ {
		r := rand.New(rand.NewSource(int64(seed)))
		in := zgen(r)
		in.Machine, in.Now = "test_box", testNow
		plan, _ := Plan(in)
		if err := ValidateTransferStage(plan); err != nil {
			if reported["overlap"] < 3 {
				t.Logf("seed %d overlap: %v\n%s", seed, err, zdump(in, plan))
			}
			reported["overlap"]++
			status(seed, "overlap")
			continue
		}
		if err := ValidateLocalOverwrites(in, plan); err != nil {
			if reported["o1"] < 3 {
				t.Logf("seed %d O1: %v\n%s", seed, err, zdump(in, plan))
			}
			reported["o1"]++
			status(seed, "o1")
			continue
		}
		kept := zkept(in)
		check := func(kind string, fail, cf map[int]bool, crash int) {
			loc, up, bad := zsim(in, plan, fail, cf, crash)
			have := map[string]bool{}
			for _, f := range loc {
				have[f.md5] = true
			}
			for p, l := range in.Local {
				if l.IsDir || kept[l.MD5] || have[l.MD5] || up[l.MD5] {
					continue
				}
				status(seed, "loss/"+kind)
				key := "loss/" + kind
				if reported[key] < 3 {
					t.Logf("seed %d LOSS (%s %v %v %d): %s (%s)\n%s", seed, kind, fail, cf, crash, p, l.MD5, zdump(in, plan))
				}
				reported[key]++
			}
			if kind == "ok" {
				for _, b := range bad {
					status(seed, "bad")
					key := "bad/" + strings.Fields(b)[0]
					if reported[key] < 3 {
						t.Logf("seed %d BAD: %s\n%s", seed, b, zdump(in, plan))
					}
					reported[key]++
				}
			}
		}
		status(seed, "ran")
		check("ok", nil, nil, -1)
		for i := range plan {
			check("fail1", map[int]bool{i: true}, nil, -1)
			check("crash", nil, nil, i)
			if plan[i].Type == MoveLocal {
				check("commitfail", nil, map[int]bool{i: true}, -1)
			}
			for j := i + 1; j < len(plan); j++ {
				check("fail2", map[int]bool{i: true, j: true}, nil, -1)
				if plan[i].Type == MoveLocal || plan[j].Type == MoveLocal {
					check("cf2", nil, map[int]bool{i: true, j: true}, -1)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	t.Logf("counts: %v", reported)
}

func TestZZDump(t *testing.T) {
	for _, s := range strings.Split(os.Getenv("ZZ_SEEDS"), ",") {
		seed, _ := strconv.Atoi(s)
		r := rand.New(rand.NewSource(int64(seed)))
		in := zgen(r)
		in.Machine, in.Now = "test_box", testNow
		plan, skips := Plan(in)
		t.Logf("seed %d O1=%v overlap=%v skips=%v\n%s", seed, ValidateLocalOverwrites(in, plan), ValidateTransferStage(plan), skips, zdump(in, plan))
	}
}


// zgenDir: folder D with files; Drive may rename D -> N (disk done or not);
// files move within/among D/N and root.
func zgenDir(r *rand.Rand) Input {
	in := Input{Base: map[string]BaseItem{"D": {FileID: "FD", IsDir: true, DriveVersion: 1}},
		Local: map[string]LocalItem{}, Remote: map[string]RemoteItem{}}
	slots := []string{"D/a.txt", "D/b.txt", "D/c.txt", "g.txt", "h.txt"}
	perm := r.Perm(len(slots))
	nb := 2 + r.Intn(3)
	for i := 0; i < nb; i++ {
		id := "I" + strconv.Itoa(i)
		in.Base[slots[perm[i]]] = BaseItem{FileID: id, Size: int64(10 + i), MD5: "B" + strconv.Itoa(i), MtimeNS: 1000, DriveMD5: "B" + strconv.Itoa(i), DriveVersion: 1}
	}
	driveRen := r.Intn(2) == 0
	localRen := driveRen && r.Intn(2) == 0
	dDir, lDir := "D", "D"
	if driveRen {
		dDir = "N"
	}
	if localRen {
		lDir = "N"
	}
	in.Remote[dDir] = RemoteItem{FileID: "FD", IsDir: true, Version: 2}
	in.Local[lDir] = LocalItem{IsDir: true}
	dslot := func(s string, dir string) string {
		if strings.HasPrefix(s, "D/") {
			return dir + s[1:]
		}
		return s
	}
	used := map[string]bool{}
	for _, p := range zsorted(mapsKeys(in.Base)) {
		b := in.Base[p]
		if b.IsDir || r.Intn(100) < 10 {
			continue
		}
		dst := p
		if r.Intn(100) < 55 {
			dst = slots[r.Intn(len(slots))]
		}
		dst = dslot(dst, dDir)
		if used[dst] {
			dst = dslot(p, dDir)
			if used[dst] {
				continue
			}
		}
		used[dst] = true
		md5, size := b.MD5, b.Size
		if r.Intn(100) < 25 {
			md5, size = "D"+b.FileID, b.Size+100
		}
		in.Remote[dst] = RemoteItem{FileID: b.FileID, MD5: md5, Size: size, Version: 2}
	}
	for k, n := range slots {
		n = dslot(n, dDir)
		if !used[n] && r.Intn(100) < 12 {
			in.Remote[n] = RemoteItem{FileID: "R" + strconv.Itoa(k), MD5: "RN" + strconv.Itoa(k), Size: int64(200 + k), Version: 1}
			used[n] = true
		}
	}
	lused := map[string]bool{}
	mt := int64(2000)
	for _, p := range zsorted(mapsKeys(in.Base)) {
		b := in.Base[p]
		if b.IsDir {
			continue
		}
		lp := dslot(p, lDir)
		x := r.Intn(100)
		switch {
		case x < 10:
			continue
		case x < 40:
			mt++
			in.Local[lp] = LocalItem{MD5: "L" + b.FileID, Size: b.Size + 50, MtimeNS: mt}
		default:
			in.Local[lp] = LocalItem{MD5: b.MD5, Size: b.Size, MtimeNS: 1000}
		}
		lused[lp] = true
	}
	for _, p := range zsorted(mapsKeys(in.Local)) {
		if in.Local[p].IsDir {
			continue
		}
		if r.Intn(100) < 10 {
			n := dslot(slots[r.Intn(len(slots))], lDir)
			if !lused[n] {
				in.Local[n] = in.Local[p]
				delete(in.Local, p)
				lused[n], lused[p] = true, false
			}
		}
	}
	for k, n := range slots {
		n = dslot(n, lDir)
		if lused[n] || r.Intn(100) > 25 {
			continue
		}
		mt++
		var md5 string
		var size int64
		switch r.Intn(3) {
		case 0:
			md5, size = "N"+strconv.Itoa(k), int64(300+k)
		case 1:
			var rs []RemoteItem
			for _, q := range zsorted(mapsKeys(in.Remote)) {
				if !in.Remote[q].IsDir {
					rs = append(rs, in.Remote[q])
				}
			}
			if len(rs) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			x := rs[r.Intn(len(rs))]
			md5, size = x.MD5, x.Size
		default:
			var bs []BaseItem
			for _, q := range zsorted(mapsKeys(in.Base)) {
				if !in.Base[q].IsDir {
					bs = append(bs, in.Base[q])
				}
			}
			x := bs[r.Intn(len(bs))]
			md5, size = x.MD5, x.Size
		}
		in.Local[n] = LocalItem{MD5: md5, Size: size, MtimeNS: mt}
		lused[n] = true
	}
	return in
}

func TestZZCounts(t *testing.T) {
	f, _ := os.Create(os.Getenv("ZZ_OUT"))
	defer f.Close()
	for seed := 0; seed < 100000; seed++ {
		r := rand.New(rand.NewSource(int64(seed)))
		in := zgen(r)
		in.Machine, in.Now = "test_box", testNow
		plan, _ := Plan(in)
		cb, up, fl := 0, 0, 0
		for _, a := range plan {
			if a.Type == ConflictBackup {
				cb++
			}
			if a.Type == Upload || a.Type == UpdateRemote {
				up++
			}
			if a.Type == Download {
				fl++
			}
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(f, "%d %d %d %d\n", seed, cb, up, fl)
	}
}


// zgen2: two nesting levels D/E, renames of D->N and/or D/E->D/F on Drive,
// done locally or not; local renames may replace tracked files; some rows
// held (shadowed on Drive or unreadable here).
func zgen2(r *rand.Rand) Input {
	in := Input{Base: map[string]BaseItem{"D": {FileID: "FD", IsDir: true, DriveVersion: 1},
		"D/E": {FileID: "FE", IsDir: true, DriveVersion: 1}},
		Local: map[string]LocalItem{}, Remote: map[string]RemoteItem{}, ShadowedRemote: map[string]bool{}, UnreadableLocal: map[string]bool{}}
	slots := []string{"D/E/a.txt", "D/E/b.txt", "D/c.txt", "D/d.txt", "g.txt", "h.txt"}
	perm := r.Perm(len(slots))
	nb := 2 + r.Intn(4)
	for i := 0; i < nb; i++ {
		id := "I" + strconv.Itoa(i)
		in.Base[slots[perm[i]]] = BaseItem{FileID: id, Size: int64(10 + i), MD5: "B" + strconv.Itoa(i), MtimeNS: 1000, DriveMD5: "B" + strconv.Itoa(i), DriveVersion: 1}
	}
	dD, dE := "D", "E"
	if r.Intn(2) == 0 {
		dD = "N"
	}
	if r.Intn(2) == 0 {
		dE = "F"
	}
	lD, lE := "D", "E"
	if dD == "N" && r.Intn(2) == 0 {
		lD = "N"
	}
	if dE == "F" && r.Intn(2) == 0 {
		lE = "F"
	}
	in.Remote[dD] = RemoteItem{FileID: "FD", IsDir: true, Version: 2}
	in.Remote[dD+"/"+dE] = RemoteItem{FileID: "FE", IsDir: true, Version: 2}
	in.Local[lD] = LocalItem{IsDir: true}
	in.Local[lD+"/"+lE] = LocalItem{IsDir: true}
	at := func(s, d, e string) string {
		if strings.HasPrefix(s, "D/E/") {
			return d + "/" + e + s[3:]
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(s, "D/") {
			return d + s[1:]
		}
		return s
	}
	used := map[string]bool{}
	for _, p := range zsorted(mapsKeys(in.Base)) {
		b := in.Base[p]
		if b.IsDir {
			continue
		}
		x := r.Intn(100)
		if x < 10 {
			continue
		}
		if x < 15 {
			in.ShadowedRemote[b.FileID] = true
			continue
		}
		dst := p
		if r.Intn(100) < 55 {
			dst = slots[r.Intn(len(slots))]
		}
		dst = at(dst, dD, dE)
		if used[dst] {
			dst = at(p, dD, dE)
			if used[dst] {
				continue
			}
		}
		used[dst] = true
		md5, size := b.MD5, b.Size
		if r.Intn(100) < 25 {
			md5, size = "D"+b.FileID, b.Size+100
		}
		in.Remote[dst] = RemoteItem{FileID: b.FileID, MD5: md5, Size: size, Version: 2}
	}
	for k, n := range slots {
		n = at(n, dD, dE)
		if !used[n] && r.Intn(100) < 12 {
			in.Remote[n] = RemoteItem{FileID: "R" + strconv.Itoa(k), MD5: "RN" + strconv.Itoa(k), Size: int64(200 + k), Version: 1}
			used[n] = true
		}
	}
	lused := map[string]bool{}
	mt := int64(2000)
	for _, p := range zsorted(mapsKeys(in.Base)) {
		b := in.Base[p]
		if b.IsDir {
			continue
		}
		lp := at(p, lD, lE)
		x := r.Intn(100)
		switch {
		case x < 10:
			continue
		case x < 13:
			in.UnreadableLocal[b.FileID] = true
			continue
		case x < 40:
			mt++
			in.Local[lp] = LocalItem{MD5: "L" + b.FileID, Size: b.Size + 50, MtimeNS: mt}
		default:
			in.Local[lp] = LocalItem{MD5: b.MD5, Size: b.Size, MtimeNS: 1000}
		}
		lused[lp] = true
	}
	for _, p := range zsorted(mapsKeys(in.Local)) {
		if in.Local[p].IsDir || r.Intn(100) >= 15 {
			continue
		}
		n := at(slots[r.Intn(len(slots))], lD, lE)
		if n == p {
			continue
		}
		// may replace an existing file (user renames over it)
		if !lused[n] || r.Intn(3) == 0 {
			in.Local[n] = in.Local[p]
			delete(in.Local, p)
			lused[n], lused[p] = true, false
		}
	}
	for k, n := range slots {
		n = at(n, lD, lE)
		if lused[n] || r.Intn(100) > 25 {
			continue
		}
		mt++
		var md5 string
		var size int64
		switch r.Intn(3) {
		case 0:
			md5, size = "N"+strconv.Itoa(k), int64(300+k)
		case 1:
			var rs []RemoteItem
			for _, q := range zsorted(mapsKeys(in.Remote)) {
				if !in.Remote[q].IsDir {
					rs = append(rs, in.Remote[q])
				}
			}
			if len(rs) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			x := rs[r.Intn(len(rs))]
			md5, size = x.MD5, x.Size
		default:
			var bs []BaseItem
			for _, q := range zsorted(mapsKeys(in.Base)) {
				if !in.Base[q].IsDir {
					bs = append(bs, in.Base[q])
				}
			}
			x := bs[r.Intn(len(bs))]
			md5, size = x.MD5, x.Size
		}
		in.Local[n] = LocalItem{MD5: md5, Size: size, MtimeNS: mt}
		lused[n] = true
	}
	return in
}

func TestZZFindMoveRemoteForget(t *testing.T) {
	found := 0
	for seed := 0; seed < 200000 && found < 3; seed++ {
		in := zgen(rand.New(rand.NewSource(int64(seed))))
		in.Machine, in.Now = "test_box", testNow
		plan, _ := Plan(in)
		for _, a := range plan {
			if a.Type == MoveRemote && !a.IsDir && a.ProtectedBy != "" {
				found++
				t.Logf("seed %d\n%s", seed, zdump(in, plan))
				break
			}
		}
	}
	t.Logf("found %d", found)
}
